# CLI reference (`adintel`)

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_reference_docs.py — edit the command's help in src/adintel/cli.py -->

Run with `.venv/bin/adintel <command> [options]`; `--help` on any command shows the same.

| Command | What it does | Options |
|---------|--------------|---------|
| `seed` | load synthetic tenants, brands, users, rules and knowledge base | `--no-kb` |
| `demo` | run one night for the canonical brands in-process | `--brands`<br>`--period-end` (YYYY-MM-DD (a Sunday); default: last Sunday) |
| `run` | run one brand now | `--tenant`<br>`--brand`<br>`--period-end` |
| `verify-audit` | verify every tenant's audit hash chain | — |
| `reconcile` | compare executed changes with approvals | — |
| `expire` | expire stale recommendations | — |
| `models` | check the mlx-lm servers behind each tier | — |
| `token` | issue a JWT for a seeded user (local only) | `--tenant`<br>`--user` |
| `outcomes` | grade executed changes 14 days later (actual vs predicted) | `--today` (YYYY-MM-DD; default: today) |
| `triage` | weekly triage report: what humans should look at next | `--tenant`<br>`--days`<br>`--format` {md, json} |
| `flags` | show or set per-tenant/brand feature flags | `--tenant`<br>`--brand`<br>`--set` (flag=on|off, e.g. agent.optimizer=off)<br>`--actor`<br>`--reason` |
| `purge` | enforce retention periods from the collection catalogue | `--dry-run` |
| `privacy-export` | export everything held about one user (access request) | `--tenant`<br>`--user`<br>`--actor`<br>`--reason` |
| `privacy-erase` | pseudonymise one user and delete their chats and notes | `--tenant`<br>`--user`<br>`--actor`<br>`--reason` |
| `offboard` | export then delete one tenant's data (agency leaves) | `--tenant`<br>`--confirm` (type the tenant id again)<br>`--out`<br>`--actor`<br>`--delete-legal-records` (also delete approvals/executions/audit) |
| `audit-archive` | copy new audit entries to write-once storage, or --verify | `--verify` (compare the database with the archive) |
| `backup` | logical backup of every collection (+ automatic restore drill) | `--out`<br>`--no-drill` |
| `restore` | restore a logical backup (refuses a non-empty database without --force) | `<source>`<br>`--force` |
| `restore-drill` | prove a backup restores cleanly, without touching live data | `<source>` |
| `migrate` | apply pending data migrations (forward-only, locked, recorded) | `--status` (list migrations and whether each is applied)<br>`--check` (exit 1 if any migration is pending (CI/deploy gate))<br>`--dry-run`<br>`--backup-dir` (take a logical backup first (the rollback for a forward-only change))<br>`--owner`<br>`--break-stale-lock` (take over a lock older than 30 minutes) |
| `csv-template` | print the bring-your-own-data CSV header | — |
| `csv-sample` | write a brand's synthetic data as template CSVs (a worked example) | `--tenant`<br>`--brand`<br>`--period-end`<br>`--days`<br>`--out` |
| `shadow-report` | challenger vs champion on live traffic (shadow mode) | `--tenant`<br>`--days` |
| `weights` | pin (lock) or verify the SHA-256 of local base-model weight files | `<action>` {lock, verify}<br>`--model` (model id (default: every local tier's model))<br>`--path` (model_id=/path/to/weights for non-HF servers) |
| `egress-check` | show which configured endpoints the egress policy allows | — |
| `secrets` | encryption at rest for local platform credentials | `<action>` {keygen, encrypt, put}<br>`--tenant`<br>`--platform`<br>`--scope` {read, write}<br>`--from-file` (JSON file with the credential values (for put)) |
| `scim` | issue a SCIM provisioning token for a tenant (shown once) | `<action>` {token}<br>`--tenant`<br>`--actor` |
| `verify-report` | verify a report JSON's signature offline (provenance) | `<file>`<br>`--public-key` (PEM from /.well-known/adintel-report-key (default: this install's key)) |
